facts.conditions: peak-to-peak inductor ripple current for the +13.5V LM2596S-ADJ non-inverting buck rail (L1 or L2). Computed inputs: VIN=15V (project PD-negotiated input), VOUT=13.5V (project intermediate rail target), f=150kHz (LM2596 fixed switching frequency), L=fact-cya1265-inductance (100uH nominal). Formula (standard non-inverting buck): dI = (Vin-Vout)*Vout / (Vin*L*f). Ripple is ~1.06% of the 8.5A Isat rating and ~2.00% of the 4.5A Idc heat-rating current -- ample margin. This is ripple current only, not full peak current (DC load current + ripple/2).
facts.locator: Calculated from fact-cya1265-inductance and the project's LM2596S-ADJ buck topology for the +13.5V rail (VIN=15V, VOUT=13.5V, f=150kHz per CLAUDE.md DC-DC Stage architecture)

facts.conditions: peak-to-peak inductor ripple current for the +7.5V LM2596S-ADJ non-inverting buck rail. Computed inputs: VIN=15V, VOUT=7.5V, f=150kHz, L=fact-cya1265-inductance (100uH nominal). Formula (standard non-inverting buck): dI = (Vin-Vout)*Vout / (Vin*L*f). Ripple is ~2.94% of the 8.5A Isat rating and ~5.56% of the 4.5A Idc heat-rating current -- ample margin. This is ripple current only, not full peak current (DC load current + ripple/2).
facts.locator: Calculated from fact-cya1265-inductance and the project's LM2596S-ADJ buck topology for the +7.5V rail (VIN=15V, VOUT=7.5V, f=150kHz per CLAUDE.md DC-DC Stage architecture)

facts.conditions: peak-to-peak inductor ripple current for the -13.5V LM2596S-ADJ inverting buck-boost rail (L3). Computed inputs: VIN=15V, VOUT=-13.5V (|Vout|=13.5V), f=150kHz, L=fact-cya1265-inductance (100uH nominal). Formula (standard inverting buck-boost): D=|Vout|/(Vin+|Vout|); dI = Vin*D/(L*f) = Vin*|Vout| / ((Vin+|Vout|)*L*f). Ripple is ~5.57% of the 8.5A Isat rating and ~10.53% of the 4.5A Idc heat-rating current -- still ample margin, though the largest of the three rails because the inverting topology has a higher duty ratio. This is ripple current only, not full peak current (DC load current + ripple/2).
facts.locator: Calculated from fact-cya1265-inductance and the project's LM2596S-ADJ inverting buck-boost topology for the -13.5V rail (VIN=15V, VOUT=-13.5V, f=150kHz per CLAUDE.md DC-DC Stage architecture)
